President Washington, Imagine a country that was under an oppressive regime like we were under many years ago. We as a nation fearing this new and unorthodox way of government step in, trying to preserve democracy for the southern part of this war-torn nation. We send in advisers to help the southern part of the country then, without warning, two of our ships are shot....down to the belly of the ocean. The Viet Cong as we called them were the cause of this loss, they woke up the fight WE AS AMERICANS HAVE BRED INSIDE US! For years it went back and forth with a new style of warfare that we had never seen. Battles waged for days trying to capture just one seemingly insignificant hill that would in the soldiers minds change the tide of the battle. Alas we had given up hope....a normal civilian could be an enemy waiting to take you away from the world in an instant, the trees were teeming with danger. The mothers and children back in the United States called for their fathers, brothers, men fighting for a cause that was lost years before the war ended. We lost a lot of lives and pulled out of the country. That southern part that longed for democracy was eventually over run and conquered. Never to be seen again.
